enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Adjust pillow. Remain sleeping. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse. Turn off tap. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on clothes. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a simple flexitarian breakfast with tea while reading the day's written reminders and timetable
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Pour cereal. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Pour milk. Take out spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Boil water. Pour tea. Read reminders. Read timetable. Drink tea. Finish eating. Stand up. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing study bag, checking notes and written to-do list before leaving
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up study bag. Open bag. Place notebook inside. Place pen inside. Place textbook inside. Zip bag. Read to-do list. Check notes. Place notes in bag. Pick up bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by train and bus to Monash University Clayton campus (public transport, no electric vehicle used)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait at platform. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Hold bag. Look at phone. Read notes. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to campus. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending postgraduate social work lectures and taking detailed written notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Sit at desk. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Open notebook. Write notes. Listen to lecturer. Write more notes. Raise hand to ask question. Write answer. Take out highlighter. Highlight key points. Turn page. Write summary. Close notebook. Pack pen. Pack notebook. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a packed vegetarian lunch and drinking tea on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to campus cafeteria. Find table. Sit down. Open bag. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Take out fork. Take out tea flask. Open flask. Pour tea into cup. Pick up fork. Eat lunch. Drink tea. Close lunch box. Pack lunch box. Pack fork. Pack flask. Stand up. Walk to bin. Throw away napkin. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending tutorials and small-group coursework discussion on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to tutorial room. Enter room. Sit at table. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Discuss with group. Write notes. Raise hand. Speak. Listen to others. Write more notes. Take out textbook. Read a passage. Share with group. Write conclusion. Pack notebook. Pack pen. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Short tea break and tidying written notes at the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to library. Sit at table. Take out notes. Organize notes. Staple pages. Put notes in folder. Take out tea flask. Pour tea. Drink tea. Pack notes. Pack flask. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading assigned articles and drafting placement reflections on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study area. Sit at desk. Take out article. Read article. Highlight important points. Take out notebook. Write reflections. Look at notes. Write more. Take out laptop. Open laptop. Type reflections. Save file. Close laptop. Pack article. Pack notebook. Pack laptop. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by train and bus from Clayton (public transport, no electric vehicle used)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Read notes. Get off train. Walk home. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking bag, drinking tea and having a light afternoon snack
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Put bag on counter. Open bag. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Take out laptop. Place on table. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Rinse lunch box. Place in dishwasher. Take out tea flask. Open flask. Pour tea into cup. Take out snack. Eat snack. Drink tea. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting quietly and reviewing lecture notes at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Take out lecture notes. Read notes. Highlight key points. Write summary. Turn page. Read more. Close notes. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Lie on bed. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a flexitarian dinner, keeping to the weekly budget plan
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out tofu. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add tofu. Add sauce. Cook. Turn off cooker. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Clear plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up dishes and tidying the shared kitchen surfaces
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Add soap. Wash plate. Wash cutlery. Rinse plate. Place in drying rack. Wash pan. Rinse pan. Place in drying rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Wipe table. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing house-meeting notes and updating the shared chore and bill reminder list
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Write house-meeting notes. Open shared chore list. Read list. Update chore assignments. Write bill reminder. Stick note on fridge. Close notebook. Put pen down. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on assignment writing on the computer at the desk with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Open assignment file. Type text. Scroll. Read reference. Type more. Save file. Check time. Stretch arms. Continue typing. Save. Close laptop. Turn off lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and brushing teeth before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly and sending text-only messages on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Type message. Send message. Read reply. Type reply. Send reply. Put phone down. Continue reading. Close book. Put book down.

enriched_activities.activity: Light stretching, then setting alarms and written reminders for the next day
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up. Stretch arms. Bend forward. Stretch legs. Sit on floor. Stretch hamstrings. Stand up. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm. Put phone down. Pick up notebook. Write reminders. Close notebook. Turn off light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Adjust pillow. Remain sleeping. Continue sleeping.
